title: Gzip decoder aborts as soon as decompressed output exceeds the cap
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the max_length argument to decompress as premature optimisation, or rejecting trailing bytes as too strict. max_length is the bomb guard itself: it guarantees the output buffer never grows past the cap plus one byte even for a hostile high-ratio stream, and trailing data is rejected so concatenated-stream smuggling cannot slip extra payload past the cap.
